allow_instructions: Read-only file inspections (glob, grep, read) are always approved.
Git read commands (status, diff, log, show, branch, stash list) run without prompting.
Git write operations (add, commit, push, merge, rebase, stash) run without prompting. Destructive patterns are caught by the deny-dangerous.sh shell hook, not by Auto-review.
Python invocations are approved, including pytest, scripts, and inline Python.
All pip and package manager installs run without prompting. Disk cost and dependency risk are known; the user manages capacity.
All shell commands run without prompting, with one exception: any command matching the global deny-dangerous patterns MUST ask the user before executing. These are the only blockers.
WebSearch and WebFetch for research are approved. The agent needs current information.
Firecrawl search, scrape, parse, and docs-search are approved. These are informational.
All MCP tool calls are approved except destructive operations that affect remote state.
Spawning any subagent (uav-reviewer, uav-implementer, uav-planner, uav-conductor, deep-research, explore, generalPurpose, shell) is approved.
File creation, editing, and deletion within the repo are approved. The user reviews changes via git diff before commit.

The single hard block is: destroying git history, deleting branches or tags, or destroying the repository. Before running any such command the agent MUST stop and ask the user for explicit confirmation.
